title: EU Company Legal Info Extractor input

domains.title: Websites or domains
domains.description: Company websites to check, one per line, e.g. 'boulangerie-dupont.fr' or 'https://www.rossi.it'.

includeNoData.title: Also return sites with no legal data
includeNoData.description: When on, sites where nothing was found are also listed, free of charge, with an error or empty fields.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to check in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page after this many seconds.

useProxy.title: Retry blocked sites through Apify Proxy
useProxy.description: If a website blocks the first request, try again through Apify Proxy. Recommended.
